SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AcceptanceRunner
Entry point of lib/AcceptanceTest.jar: runs AcceptanceTest with JUnit and shows the result in a dialog, so the acceptance test can be started with a double click, without an IDE.
AcceptanceTest
Acceptance test for the slot machine.
Canvas
Canvas allows simple graphical drawing.
DizzySymbol
A symbol that gets dizzy: every time its wheel spins, its triangle flips upside down (and back again on the next spin).
EphemeralSymbol
An ephemeral symbol: every time its wheel spins, its triangle shrinks one step (staying equilateral) until it is just a point, whether or not it is the symbol being shown.
LazyWheel
A wheel that only responds to every other spin request.
LeftyWheel
A wheel that copies the state of the wheel to its left.
MessageUtil
JOptionPane utility class for global application alerts MessageUtil
RebelWheel
A wheel that resists being locked, swapped or removed, but can still be spun and have its symbols changed.
Rectangle
A rectangle that can be manipulated and that draws itself on a canvas.
ShySymbol
A shy symbol: each time its wheel stops at it (after a spin or a placeSymbol) it toggles between hiding and showing, starting by hiding.
SlotMachine
A slot machine: a gray board with a grid of up to 14 x 9 Wheels.
SlotMachineC1Test
The SlotMachine test class for cycle 1.
SlotMachineC2Test
The SlotMachine test class for cycle 2.
SlotMachineC4Test
The SlotMachine test class for cycle 4: the different types of wheels (normal, lefty, rebel, lazy) and of symbols (normal, ephemeral, shy, dizzy).
SlotMachineCC4Test
Shared tests of cycle 4 written by other groups.
SlotMachineContest
Solves the ICPC 2025 World Finals problem I "Slot Machine": rotate n wheels of n symbols until all show the same one (a jackpot), seeing only SlotMachine.distinctSymbols(), never the symbols themselves.
SlotMachineContestCTest
Shared unit tests for SlotMachineContest, compatible across group implementations since they verify invariants any correct solution to the contest problem must satisfy, rather than implementation details specific to one group's algorithm.
SlotMachineContestTest
Unit tests for SlotMachineContest: verifies that solve(n) produces a valid action sequence reaching jackpot within the action limit, and that simulate(n) makes the resolved machine visible.
SlotMachineCoverageTest
Coverage tests for the domain package: error cases and branches of SlotMachine, Wheel and SlotMachineContest that the cycle tests don't reach.
SlotMachineException
Exception thrown when an operation of the slot machine can't be done.
SlowMachineCC2Test
The test class SlowMachineCC2Test.
Symbol
A symbol of a wheel: its name (a color such as "red" or "#3fae1c") and the Triangle that draws it.
Triangle
A triangle that can be manipulated and that draws itself on a canvas.
Wheel
A wheel of the slot machine: a background slot (Rectangle) and its own Symbols.
